newsitem.title: USA: Edison selling Canada gas pipeline capacity.
newsitem.headline: Edison selling Canada gas pipeline capacity.

text.p: Edison International's Southern California Edison Co said Friday it is trying to sell its firm natural gas transportation capacity on several pipelines originating in Alberta, Canada.
The move was prompted by the utility's decision late last year to sell all of its gas-fired generating plants.
Under California's restructuring of the electric utility industry, Edison, along with Pacific Gas and Electric Co (PG&E), was required to divest at least half of its thermal generation units.
Edison said it holds 200 million cubic feet per day of firm capacity on pipelines owned by Alberta Natural Gas Co (ANG), Pacific Gas Transmission Co (PGT) and PG&E pipelines.
Agreements with ANG extend through October 2008 and through October 2023 with the PGT and PG&E lines.
